ask: I have fallen for this piece, and I can already see it on my wall. How big is it? Is the price firm?
text:
Dear Leo,

Thank you so much for your message—Ines will be delighted to hear how strongly you connect with *Tidewrack III*.

The work (2025, oil and beeswax on linen, exhibited at Fold Gallery in March) measures 120 x 90 cm. In the interest of full transparency, I also want to mention that there is a faint scuff on the lower left edge of the frame; I would be very happy to send over a close-up photograph so you can see it clearly.

The listed price is £4,000, though it isn't strictly firm. There is some room for flexibility, so if you have an offer in mind, please feel free to share it and I will be glad to discuss it with Ines for you.

Warm regards,
Ines's Studio
